definitions.name: gateway preserves forced tool bodies and headers in compatible, native and Auto profiles
gateway rejects malformed consumed shapes before evaluation, token counting or upstream forwarding
unfamiliar provider extensions and native same-model contracts pass through unmodified
internal token counting avoids incompatible targets and retains native provider-owned requests

network_scope: 18 actual synthetic gateway requests and eight provider calls; original mocked Jev/count fetch callbacks only. No evaluator/provider network calls.
capture_semantics: All four original callbacks and five helpers execute with their source assertions intact. Recording delegates original route/count callbacks and actual local HTTP. All body bytes, semantic headers, private logs, counter results and complete evaluator/count request/response reads remain raw. Undefined direct count results are explicit tagged source values, never normalized to null. Only declared automatic dates, generated request IDs, validated measured observation timings and loopback authorities are projected; raw captures/projection ledger retain every original value.
